style.styleTitle: Homcom 4ft Artificial Christmas Tree Tall Design
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Let the bright multicoloured LED lights on this 4 ft Christmas tree, from HOMCOM, bring some beautiful magic into your home this season. A full-bodied style which stands proud and tall, it s covered with 130 fibre optic lights in red, green, and blue, so it sparkles brightly and beautifully with the pre-set patterns doing the hard work for you. It s completed with a metal base, which keeps the tree stable and upright. Also includes a star topper for placing your own angel on for tradition.</p><ul><li>Features 130 LED fibre optic lights in red, green, yellow and blue for a dazzling display;</li><li>Star topper attached to fix your own angel, star or other type of tree topping;</li><li>Metal base keeps the tree weight and in place;</li><li>Beautiful full-bodied design in a 4 ft height to stand proud in your home or office;</li><li>Branches are able to support your own decorations and tinsel;</li><li>Easy to assemble;</li><li>Colour: Green, red and blue;</li><li>Materials: PVC and metal;</li><li>Cord: 1.8m;</li><li>Branch tip count: 130 branches. LED light count: 130;</li><li>Input: 100-240V 50/60Hz. Output: 12V/12W;</li><li>Custom label: 830-017V70;</li><li>Note:;</li></ul><p>Only the tree with the stand is included. Ornaments are NOT INCLUDED and are used just for effect;</p><p>The remote control is not included;</p>
